user.title: Connect to Canvas LMS
user.description: Choose how to connect Home Assistant to Canvas.

browser_session.title: Connect with Browser Session Cookie
browser_session.description: Paste the Cookie request header from a logged-in Canvas browser session. The full value is recommended, for example `canvas_session=...; _csrf_token=...`.

oauth_setup.title: Connect with Canvas OAuth
oauth_setup.description: Enter your Canvas base URL plus the OAuth client ID and client secret from a Canvas Developer Key. Your Canvas admin must allow the redirect URI `{redirect_uri}`.

reauth_session.title: Refresh Canvas Browser Session
reauth_session.description: Paste a fresh Canvas Cookie header value for `{host}`.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid Canvas base URL.

abort.already_configured: This Canvas account is already configured.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the Canvas sign-in URL.
abort.missing_oauth_configuration: This entry does not have enough OAuth configuration to reauthenticate. Remove and add it again.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant does not have an external URL available for OAuth redirect setup.
abort.oauth_failed: Canvas rejected the OAuth token exchange.
abort.oauth_error: Canvas OAuth succeeded, but the returned access token could not be validated.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while finishing the Canvas OAuth exchange.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Canvas reported that this OAuth client is no longer authorized.
abort.wrong_account: The authorized Canvas account does not match the existing integration entry.

init.title: Canvas LMS options
init.description: Tune how often the integration refreshes and how far ahead assignments are tracked.
